newsitem.title: POLAND: LG seen buying Petrobank on kerb.
newsitem.headline: LG seen buying Petrobank on kerb.

text.p: The South Korean majority holder of Poland's Petrobank SA is likely to increase its stake in the bank through the Warsaw bourse's kerb on Thursday, the shares' broker said on Tuesday.
LG Investment Holdings BV, a subsidiary of South Korea's LG Group which holds more than 50 percent of Petrobank, could complete the deal in the next few days, the head of the brokerage told Reuters.

"On January 23 or the following two work days there could be a Petrobank kerb deal through the bourse. The whole thing should be over in a few days " said Krzysztof Pernach, the head of Citibrokerage SA, which is accepting sell offers in LG's tender for Petrobank's remaining common shares.
Last month LG Investment Holdings, as required by Polish law, announced a public tender offer to buy the remaining shares at 12 zlotys each from all shareholders willing to sell.
In November LG Group bought 11,128,250 shares representing 50 percent plus one share in Petrobank, based in the central city of Lodz, at 12 zlotys per share.
On Tuesday Petrobank closed at 12.3 zlotys on the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
